title: PandocRequest
description: Everything one pandoc run needs, as data. Built by Rust (PandocWriteStage::prepare); executed natively with Command or by the wasm host in a worker. Byte fields (definition 'bytes') are base64 strings in this JSON form; the object the wasm entry point returns carries Uint8Array instead (x-q2-wire).

schema_version.description: Integer; bumped on a breaking change. The host refuses a version it does not know.

kind.description: What the request runs. Reserved: PDF may later be a second job fed by the first. Default pandoc.

job_id.description: Opaque to TS, computed by Rust: first 16 hex digits of sha256 over the canonical JSON (keys sorted, no whitespace) of {schema_version, tool: expected_pandoc_wasm_sha256, argv[1..], env minus SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH, files: {path: sha256}, resource_refs: {path: sha256}, share_tree: share_tree_version}.

argv.description: The whole argv. argv[0] is the literal 'pandoc'; no +RTS options. Path-valued entries are absolute and '/'-normalized.

env.description: The environment, fixed at init. Allowlisted keys only (never LANG or LC_*). SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH is present in wasm requests (click time in production, fixed in tests) and absent natively.

files.description: Files this request creates (input JSON, the empty dependency file, staged templates). Not the share tree. Identical entries are deduped; a path in two of share tree/files/resource_refs/dirs, or both file and directory, is an error.

dirs.description: Directories that must exist on their own (empty ones: the output's parent, .quarto/, /tmp in wasm mode). Directories that only parent a file are implicit.

resource_refs.description: Document resources (images, reference docs) the run reads: paths and bytes copied by Rust in the same synchronous step. TS never reads the VFS. In wasm mode no path may start with the share root or /tmp.

share_root.description: The temp root. In wasm mode the constant /__q2_share__ (resources/pandoc-wasm.json), reserved for the share tree and files.

share_tree_path.description: Where the host mounts the share tree: <share_root>/pandoc-share, the value of QUARTO_SHARE_PATH.

output_path.description: Where pandoc writes its output (the -o value).

json_path.description: The input JSON path; passed back to classify_pandoc_completion.

post.description: What runs after pandoc. none for docx, pptx and epub; compile_typst is reserved for PDF.

expected_pandoc_wasm_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the decompressed pandoc.wasm (resources/pandoc-wasm.json). The loader checks it on every load.

share_tree_version.description: SHA-256 over the sorted (path, bytes) entries of the share tree (FILTERS_DIR, DATADIR_DIR and FORMATS_DOCX_DIR, deduped). The host re-reads the tree only when this changes.

typst_available_fonts.description: Echo of render_pandoc_request's input of the same name; null until the PDF work.

path.description: A '/'-normalized absolute path: starts with '/' (or 'X:/' for a native Windows request) and contains no backslash.

bytes.description: Raw bytes. Base64 (standard alphabet, padded) in JSON; Uint8Array on the wasm wire object.
